entities.name: Marinus of Tyre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marinus of Tyre was a Greek-speaking Phoenician Roman geographer, cartographer and mathematician, who founded mathematical geography and provided the underpinnings of Claudius Ptolemy's influential Geography.
